title: Seventh-Rank Skewer
setup: The black king on d7 and its queen on h7 share the seventh rank with nothing at all in between.
hint: Which square beside the black king is already covered by another white piece? Check from the rank they share.
explanation:
## The Idea

The king on **d7** and the queen on **h7** sit on one rank. {{Qc7+}} checks from the other end, and the bishop on **b6** guards c7, so the king may not take. After {{Ke8}} the rank is clear and {{Qxh7}} collects the queen.
